utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. If you can help with the repair drive, I’d be grateful—starting with the front gate would help me most.

utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the front gate for the repair drive, and I’ll keep you posted as the details come together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. That means a lot—starting with the front gate is a big help.
